title: passiflora suberosa var. pallida
intro: Passiflora suberosa var. pallida, commonly known as the White False Passionflower, is a species of flowering plant in the passionflower family. It is used in traditional medicine to promote relaxation and relieve anxiety due to its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving sleep quality, and alleviating symptoms of menopause. The therapeutic actions of Passiflora suberosa var. pallida include sedative and anti-anxiety effects, making it a potential natural remedy for insomnia and stress-related disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its therapeutic actions.
